$comment: Initial component hierarchy (Phase 1). Nested tree: system > assembly > subassembly > component. 'status' is the verification status of the component's EXISTENCE and placement on the target tractor, not of any part number. Omitted status = unverified. 'appliesTo' uses variant axes from data/configurations.json; omitted = all target configurations. 'supplierClaimedOem' lists OEM numbers quoted by suppliers; they are NOT verified OEM part numbers until checked against parts book SRC-032. IDs are stable and must never be renamed once 3D objects reference them. 'replacementReferences' lists current AGCO supply numbers (SRC-038, 2008 Heritage catalogue) for the part: they are replacement references, not the original 1958 parts-book number. 'confidence' is 'listed' when the catalogue row names the 23C / 35 diesel / FE35 or the 35 without an engine restriction, and 'possible' when the row depends on a US serial range or does not name the engine.

children.name: Cylinder liner
children.notes: Removable flanged sleeves: top flange sits in a recess in the upper block, spigot in the lower block; withdrawn upwards with the pistons (SRC-035 B.32–B.33). The manual does not say wet or dry: SRC-008/SRC-018 say dry, SRC-007 groups the 23C with wet-liner engines. Recorded conflict.

replacementReferences.models: Printed "175 23C Diesel Engine"; "175" is almost certainly a misprint for 35

children.name: PTO system
children.notes: Confirmed fitted on the owner's tractor. 540 rpm at 1,500 engine rpm. Live with the dual clutch, through the single clutch otherwise.

children.name: PTO drive shaft (through gearbox)
children.notes: Dual clutch: tubular shaft from the rear disc around the gearbox input shaft, geared to a solid shaft through the hollow countershaft (SRC-035 J.4).

children.name: Hydraulic lift system
children.notes: Confirmed fitted on owner's tractor. Pump is driven with the PTO drive line, so it runs with the second clutch stage engaged on dual-clutch tractors (SRC-001, SRC-010). Draft control and position control both present (SRC-009, SRC-023).
